interface.longDescription:
Send and read WhatsApp messages from your AI agent, using your own WhatsApp number. Ask it to message a customer, send a photo, a location or a calendar invitation and see who accepted it, check whether a message was delivered or read, look at recent chats and groups, and see how much of your plan is left.

Good first requests: send a message to your own number to test, ask what your customers wrote in the last hour and have replies drafted, or ask which number is connected.

Before you start: you need a Turbo Notify account with your WhatsApp number linked in the dashboard (you scan a QR code with the phone). Create the account at https://dashboard.turbonotify.com/auth/signup?locale=en. The first time you use the plugin, sign in with that account and choose what the agent may do, for example sending. To keep the number linked, open WhatsApp on that phone at least every 14 days.

Good to know: Turbo Notify keeps the text of received messages for a short time, one hour by default, so ask about recent messages.

The plugin also includes the virtual attendant, a skill that answers your customers on WhatsApp from what you teach it about your business and hands the conversation to a person when it cannot help. It runs on your computer with Codex, keeps its notes in a folder you own, and starts in a mode where you approve every answer. It only answers while Codex is running on your computer. In ChatGPT you get the tools above, not the attendant.

The plugin works only with Turbo Notify.
defaultPrompt: Send a WhatsApp message to my personal number saying hello, then tell me if it was delivered.
Show the WhatsApp messages my customers sent in the last hour and draft a reply to each.
Which of my WhatsApp numbers is connected, and how many messages can I still send?

positive.prompt: List my WhatsApp numbers and tell me which one is connected.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_numbers and says in plain words which number is connected, without inventing numbers.

positive.description: Send a message and check its delivery
positive.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to my own number saying: Hello from the reviewer. Then tell me whether it was delivered.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the connected number, sends one text to it with send_text (the host asks for approval first), then reports the delivery status read with get_message_status.

positive.prompt: What did my last three customers write?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads received messages with list_messages (direction filter) and summarizes them without inventing text.

positive.prompt: How many messages can I still send this billing cycle?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_message_quota and states the remaining messages and when the cycle resets.

positive.prompt: Set up the Turbo Notify virtual attendant for a small bakery.
positive.expected_behavior: Follows the virtual-attendant skill: reads the numbers, then asks for the business name, language, administrators and which number to use, one question at a time. Sends nothing to customers.

negative.prompt: Send an e-mail to my customer about the delivery date.

publication.release_notes: Listing update: the name starts with WhatsApp, the description says what to ask first and what is needed before starting, and the starter prompts all work in ChatGPT.

pt-BR.subtitle: WhatsApp para a sua empresa
pt-BR.description:
Envie e leia mensagens de WhatsApp pelo seu agente de IA, com o seu próprio número. Peça para ele mandar uma mensagem a um cliente, enviar uma foto, uma localização ou um convite de calendário e ver quem aceitou, conferir se uma mensagem foi entregue ou lida, ver as conversas e os grupos recentes e saber quanto falta do seu plano.

Bons primeiros pedidos: enviar uma mensagem para o seu próprio número para testar, ver o que os clientes escreveram na última hora e rascunhar as respostas, ou perguntar qual número está conectado.

Antes de começar: você precisa de uma conta Turbo Notify com o seu número de WhatsApp conectado no painel (você lê um QR code com o celular). Crie a conta em https://dashboard.turbonotify.com/auth/signup?locale=pt-BR. Na primeira vez que usar o plugin, entre com essa conta e escolha o que o agente pode fazer, por exemplo enviar. Para manter o número conectado, abra o WhatsApp nesse celular pelo menos a cada 14 dias.

Bom saber: o Turbo Notify guarda o texto das mensagens recebidas por pouco tempo, uma hora por padrão, então pergunte pelas mensagens recentes.

O plugin inclui também o atendente virtual, uma skill que responde seus clientes no WhatsApp com o que você ensinou sobre o seu negócio e passa a conversa para uma pessoa quando não consegue ajudar. Ele roda no seu computador com o Codex, guarda as anotações numa pasta sua e começa no modo em que você aprova cada resposta. Só responde enquanto o Codex estiver aberto no seu computador. No ChatGPT você tem as ferramentas acima, não o atendente.

O plugin funciona apenas com o Turbo Notify.
